name: vero-dotto
description: Read true. Spend less. Claude reads your docx, pdf, spreadsheets and OpenDocument files as clean markdown - converted automatically, cached, with the token saving shown.

autoSetup.title: Set up converters automatically
autoSetup.description: Download uv, Python and the converters (~240 MB, once) into ~/.cache/verodotto on the first session. Off: only /vero-dotto setup does it.

minSavingPercent.title: Minimum saving, percent
minSavingPercent.description: Below this estimated token saving the original file is read as it is.

maxFileMb.title: Largest file converted, MB
maxFileMb.description: A document larger than this is read as it is, and you are told it was skipped.

maxSheetCells.title: Largest sheet converted in full, cells
maxSheetCells.description: A spreadsheet with a sheet over this many cells is summarised instead.

maxSheetRows.title: Rows per sheet in a summary
maxSheetRows.description: How many rows of each sheet a spreadsheet summary shows.

maxTokens.title: Largest spreadsheet conversion, tokens
maxTokens.description: A spreadsheet whose markdown is estimated above this is summarised instead.

bandForReads.title: Band for files Claude opens itself
bandForReads.description: Show the saving above the prompt for documents Claude read on its own too. Off: only for documents named in your prompt.

bandSeconds.title: Keep the row this long, seconds
bandSeconds.description: The row above the prompt stays through your next two prompts, or this many seconds, whichever is longer. 0: two prompts only.

cacheDays.title: Keep unused conversions, days
cacheDays.description: Conversions not used for this long are removed by the daily clean-up.

cacheMaxMb.title: Conversion cache cap, MB
cacheMaxMb.description: Above this size the least recently used conversions are removed. The converters themselves are never counted or removed.

convertTimeoutSec.title: Conversion time limit, seconds
convertTimeoutSec.description: A conversion that takes longer is stopped and the original file is read instead.
